problem.text: The change standardizes Linear.quant_format_id() from uppercase "EXL3" to lowercase "exl3", matching the spelling already written into quantization metadata.

reasoning.text: The producer changes, but its metadata consumer still compares against "EXL3". Consistent capitalization requires updating that comparison too; changing only the producer prevents the recognition branch from running.

impact.text: For recognized EXL3 linear leaves, generated metadata retains stored_tensors but omits quant_format and bits_per_weight. Both compilation and the standalone metadata utility call the affected generator.

source_notes.text: The parent entry describes the newly introduced header-derived inventory and its per-leaf format and bit-width fields.

limitations: No model conversion, metadata utility, or GPU implementation was executed. The Python check transcribed only the consumer branch using synthetic header metadata.
External consumers of quant_format_id() were not established.

chapters.title: Lowercase format identifier and its metadata consumer

claims.text: Linear.quant_format_id() classifies storage under the primary module key using trellis plus the su/suh and sv/svh alternatives. The patch changes only the successful return string; unrecognized storage still returns None, and weight-loading behavior is unchanged.

create_quantization_config_json constructs a model without loading weights, visits leaf modules, records stored tensor headers, and uses quant_format_id() to decide whether to add EXL3-specific metadata. Its serialized quant_format value was already lowercase before this patch.

A scalar transcription with a synthetic trellis last dimension of 48 produced quant_format='exl3' and bits_per_weight=3 for the old identifier, but only stored_tensors for the new identifier. This checks the case-sensitive branch, not repository execution.

findings.description: The lowercase return value no longer matches the unchanged uppercase metadata discriminator.
findings.trigger: Generate quantization_config.json for a model containing a leaf Linear whose primary-key storage satisfies is_exl3_storage().
findings.expected_behavior: Preserve the leaf's quant_format='exl3' and header-derived bits_per_weight fields while standardizing the identifier.
findings.actual_behavior: The EXL3 branch is skipped, so those two fields are omitted while stored_tensors remains.

verification.description: Parent-tree searches located the direct metadata consumer and its compilation and standalone-utility callers. The complete task diff changes only Linear's return string, leaving the uppercase comparison intact.
verification.limits: Reach is established for these inspected repository call sites, not external or dynamically selected callers.

verification.description: Ran a standard-library reproduction of the metadata branch with old and new identifier strings.
verification.limits: Synthetic dictionary input; no repository model construction or file generation was executed.

annotation.summary: Lowercases Linear's EXL3 format identifier, but leaves its metadata consumer checking uppercase, causing EXL3-specific inventory fields to be omitted.
